description: A twelve-step sequencer with a voltage knob and a step output for every step, an internal clock, an adjustable length and an output scaler

params.text: Sets the voltage that step sends to the CV output, from -10V to 10V before the range knob scales it
Turns that step's contribution to the trigger output on and off, the lamp beside it showing the state
Sends the sequence back to step one
Starts and stops the sequence, the lamp beside it lit while it runs
Sets the tempo of the internal clock, from 15 to 960 beats a minute, and is ignored while a cable is in the clock jack
Sets how many steps are played before the sequence returns to the first, from 1 to 12
Scales the CV output, from silence at the bottom to the full ±10V of the step knobs at the top

inputs.text: A rising edge sends the sequence back to step one; it reads high above 2V
A rising edge starts or stops the sequence; it reads high above 2V
A rising edge advances the sequence by one step and takes the tempo away from the internal clock; it reads high above 2V

outputs.text: Carries 10V while that step is the one playing, and 0V otherwise
A 1ms trigger at 10V each time the sequence moves to a new step
A 1ms trigger at 10V each time the sequence moves to a step whose button is on
The voltage knob of the step playing, scaled by the range knob

notes: it comes up running with every step switched on, so it plays as soon as a clock or the internal tempo carries it
a clock arriving during the 1ms reset pulse is ignored, so a reset and a clock on the same edge do not advance twice

inputs.0:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
